evidenceProfile.reason:
Glycine and alanine are2-aminoethanoic and2-aminopropanoic acid, numbered from carboxyl carbonC1. The reverse serine connectivity HOCH2−CH(NH2)−COOH and the erroneous1-aminopropanoic-acid counterexample require rule application beyond naming the two shown examples. No stereochemistry is inferred from connectivity alone.

The real v2 P36 source retains the original v1 case pair unchanged. The target description is unchanged; the narrower e9d prerequisite supplies amino-acid group/protonation foundations without requiring unrelated stereochemistry. The new PNG locatesC1/C2 correctly. The written transfer is still independent of recognizing that image.

The current target is systematic naming. It requires derived nomenclature and connectivity, not an unrequested actual experiment. Trivial-name recall does not substitute for applying numbering and substituent rules.

This is the literal naming contribution; it is not a full Bavarian course or nationwide source approval. The existing no_memory_needed status is preserved without a new M vote.

expectations.essentialUnderstandingDe: Systematische Namen legen Stammkette, Carboxyl-C als C1 und Aminogruppenposition fest.
expectations.essentialUnderstandingEn: Systematic names specify parent chain, carboxyl C1 and amino-group position.
expectations.observablePerformanceDe: 2-Aminoethansäure und 2-Aminopropansäure; das Carboxyl-C ist C1. Trivialnamen Glycin/Alanin dürfen ergänzen, ersetzen aber die Regelanwendung nicht.
expectations.observablePerformanceEn: 2-aminoethanoic acid and 2-aminopropanoic acid; carboxyl carbon is C1. Glycine/alanine can supplement but do not replace rule application.

expectations.essentialUnderstandingDe: Die gleiche fachliche Beziehung wird auf einen veränderten Fall übertragen; Bedingungen und Schlussgrenzen werden benannt.
expectations.essentialUnderstandingEn: The same subject relationship is transferred to a changed case with explicit conditions and inference limits.
expectations.observablePerformanceDe: HO-CH2-CH(NH2)-COOH; Amino an C2, Hydroxy an C3. Der Fehler verwechselt Carboxyl-C1 und alpha-C2; ohne Zusatz ist keine Stereokonfiguration behauptet.
expectations.observablePerformanceEn: HO-CH2-CH(NH2)-COOH; amino at C2 and hydroxy at C3. Error confuses carboxyl C1 and alpha C2; no stereoconfiguration is asserted without further notation.

variationAxes.textDe: Material, Stoffstruktur, Messbedingung oder Bewertungsdossier wechseln wie in den zwei ausdrücklich ausgearbeiteten Fällen; quantitative Angaben sind synthetische Aufgabenwerte.
variationAxes.textEn: Material, molecular structure, measurement conditions or evaluation dossier vary as explicitly specified in the two worked cases; numerical values are synthetic task data.
